spans.s: (by Sandhi for ऋधत् pres. p. of ऋध् cl. 6).
ऋधद्—री (√ री) mfn. one whose speed is increasing or excessive, exceedingly swift (as horses), RV. viii, 46, 23.
ऋधद्—वार mfn. one whose wealth is increasing or abundant, abounding in wealth (said of Agni), RV. vi, 3, 2.
(and ऋध॑क्, SV.), ind. (related to अर्ध, BRD.), separately, aside, apart
in a distinguished manner, particularly, RV.
ऋधङ्—मन्त्र mfn. one who is destitute of speech [BRD.], AV. v, 1, 7.
